Use sensory descriptions.
The gentle cobbled stones clicked rhythmily against her boots beneath my weight as if playing an upbeat song, guiding a solitary walk. As the morning sunlight pierced between leaves in layers above the tree lined walk way I could make a mental map from each shadow and shape of light filtering into the ground and into me as if my very existence could not escape it. 
My usual walk home through these streets, past that same row houses with a single tree growing from each lawn - it never ceased in beauty. Each leaf, branch or stone, they seemed so small to my eyes in isolation. I would see their beauty only once in the grand context. And the houses were so uniform - identical - like rows on endless paper of ink dots - each house a monstrossy of uniform samilarity. The only break in pattern were that one
